UNKNOWN_ERROR.hint: Run the command again or inspect debug output.

TUI_RENDER_FAILED.hint: Run again with --plain if you need plain output.

UNKNOWN_ARGUMENT.hint: Run `envio --help` to see the supported syntax.

MISSING_FLAG_VALUE.hint: Pass a non-empty value after the option.

CONFIG_REQUIRED.hint: Check the required configuration and run the command again.

LOGIN_REQUIRED.hint: Run `envio login` before creating a project.

REPOSITORY_URL_INVALID.hint: Use a GitHub repository URL such as https://github.com/owner/repo.

REPOSITORY_CONTEXT_MISMATCH.message: Repository URL does not match the current Git repository.

GITHUB_APP_NOT_INSTALLED.message: Envio GitHub App is not installed for this repository.

REPOSITORY_ACCESS_DENIED.message: Envio cannot access this GitHub repository.

PROJECT_ALREADY_EXISTS.message: This project is already registered in Envio.

NO_AVAILABLE_MEMBER_DEVICE.message: No collaborator device with a registered public key is available.

LOCAL_LINK_CONFIG_CONFLICT.message: Local link config path conflicts with an existing file.

INVALID_REPOSITORY_URL.hint: Use a valid GitHub repository URL.

REPOSITORY_PARSE_FAILED.message: Repository URL could not be parsed.
REPOSITORY_PARSE_FAILED.hint: Use a GitHub repository URL that can be parsed as owner/repo.

INVALID_PUBLIC_KEY_FORMAT.message: Device public key format is invalid.
INVALID_PUBLIC_KEY_FORMAT.hint: Run `envio login` again to register a valid device public key.

INVALID_DEVICE_ID.hint: Run `envio login` again to register this device.

UNAUTHORIZED.hint: Run `envio login` before linking a project.

PROJECT_ACCESS_DENIED.message: Envio access to this GitHub repository is denied.

PROJECT_NOT_FOUND.message: This project is not registered in Envio yet.

JOIN_STATUS_PENDING.message: Project join approval is not completed yet.

WRAPPED_MASTER_KEY_NOT_READY.message: Project key is not ready yet.

USER_DEVICE_KEY_NOT_REGISTERED.message: Current device key is not registered.

PROJECT_LINK_REQUIRED.message: This repository is not linked to an Envio project.

LOCAL_SESSION_MISMATCH.message: Local project session does not match the current login.

PROJECT_MASTER_KEY_REQUIRED.hint: Run `envio link` again to restore this project's key on the current device.

HISTORY_VERSION_NOT_FOUND.message: Environment history version was not found.
